text:
damon: Heads-up - vendor NimbusEdge submitted an invoice today (2397654321) for a Q1 spot true-up: amount USD 34,120. Invoice includes a FX adjustment line in EUR that wasn't in our PO. Need guidance on accrual vs vendor dispute before close.
keiko: Do we have the PO/contract mapping? Our PO shows monthly prepaid reserves for Dedicated, spot usage billed monthly.
trey: quick look 10: invoice lines: Dedicated reserved 12,000 (matches PO), Spot usage 18,000, FX adj +4,120 EUR->USD conversion fee. Vendor claims bank charge; we didn't expect that.
damon: For month-end: recognize expense for services received (Dedicated + Spot) for period. FX bank/processing fees are typically recognized when invoiced unless disputed. But if vendor inflated conversion we should flag.
keiko: Suggest provisional JE to accrue service portion only (30,000) and put FX adj 4,120 on hold in a suspense GL until cleared. That keeps COGS accurate and doesn't overstate expense.
try: FYI our AP policy: any disputed fee >2k requires vendor confirmation before payment.
yara: I can approve accrual JE up to 40k for provisional booking.

Draft provisional JE (to post tonight):
``
Date: 2026-03-31
Dr: Cloud Services Expense - Dedicated      12,000
Dr: Cloud Services Expense - Spot           18,000
Dr: Suspense - FX Disputes                  4,120
Cr: Accrued Expenses                        34,120
Memo: NimbusEdge invoice 2397654321 - provisional accrual; FX fee in suspense pending vendor clarification.
```

damon: Action items: @trey attach invoice and PO to thread and open vendor inquiry; @keiko prepare reversing JE template for next month if vendor eliminates FX line. Tagging monthend/close and GL-ops.
it-invoices-bot: Invoice and PO attached: /invoices/vendor/nimbusedge/2397654321.pdf, /pos/po-98765.pdf
payables-bot: Payment blocked for invoice 2397654321 pending dispute resolution.
keiko: I'll reach out to vendor procurement contact now and cc legal if vendor resists. Expect response within 48 hours.
yara: Approved. Post provisional JE and note in close pack. :white_check_mark: 
damon: Thanks team. We'll update the close commentary with the suspense amount and expected reversal timing.
